overview: The Medford City Council approved a Common Victualler license, discussed funding strategies for the new public library and tree preservation, and referred a used auto permit and tree ordinance to future meetings or committees.

items.title: Harlem Wizards PTO Event Announcement
items.summary: Approved a petition announcing the March 13 Harlem Wizards basketball game to benefit elementary school PTOs.

items.title: Common Victualler License for 7-Eleven
items.summary: Approved a Common Victualler license for 7-Eleven at 69 Fellsway West with a 90-day review requirement after the 24-hour operation request was withdrawn.

items.title: Class II Special Permit for ALC Auto Sales
items.summary: Continued the public hearing on a Class II Used Auto Sales Special Permit for 407 Rear Mystic Ave to March 12, 2019, due to the petitioner's absence and pending building department safety clarification.

items.title: Tufts University PILOT Negotiations Update
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update on payment in lieu of taxes negotiations with Tufts University and identifying other eligible tax-exempt nonprofits.

items.title: Update on Opioid Lawsuit Against Sackler Family
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting details and financial impacts regarding the city's lawsuit against pharmaceutical manufacturers.

items.title: Enforcement of City Sign Ordinance
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that code enforcement issue sign ordinance notices to local businesses and check specific locations for compliance.

items.title: Tree Preservation, Protection, and Replacement Ordinance
items.summary: Referred a proposed tree preservation and replacement ordinance to the Zoning Subcommittee for further drafting with city departments.

items.title: Library Capital Campaign and Funding Strategy
items.summary: Discussed municipal funding obligations for the $34 million library project and approved a request to examine Community Preservation Act eligibility.

items.title: Firefighter Gear Safety Report
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a report on firefighter gear materials and asking state legislators to support a toxic chemical reduction bill.

items.title: Transportation Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Adopted the Transportation Subcommittee report concerning safety improvements at the Main Street and South Street corridor and discussed upcoming MBTA bus rerouting.
